race.comment: PECCAVI (16) has been doing his best work late since resuming and looms a big danger fourth-up stretching to this trip. If Jones can take advantage of the inside draw she will prove tough to hold out. GIAPPONESE (1) beat several of these last start at this track and stays in the mix despite conceding some big weight swings. GREAT TIMES AHEAD (12) has progressed nicely this campaign and is well placed to go on with the job after shedding his maiden tag last time. The rise in trip should suit and Thompson sticking is a big push. READY FOR THE TRIP (5) finished alongside GIAPPONESE last time and now meets him with a 3.5kg swing after Youngberry's claim. No reason he can't turn the tables.
